'''General Population''', or '''Gen Pop''', was a large area aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], in which the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were sequestered. The vast majority of inmates in Gen Pop were killed when the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing]] virus spread through the area.
